scenario.description:
# Break Escape SAFETYNET Mission 3: Ghost in the Machine
Virtual machines for the Break Escape SAFETYNET mission 3 narrative experience. Zero Day Syndicate sold Ghost the way into St. Catherine's. The trail leads to WhiteHat Security, a respectable pentest firm with Zero Day's exploit market running out of its back rooms. This is their isolated training network - the box they rehearse exploits on before they sell them.
## Your Objectives
1. **Map the training network** - Sweep the lab and read the services it exposes 2. **Pull the FTP intelligence** - The FTP box runs the trojaned ProFTPD build they sold Ghost 3. **Decode the pricing intel** - The web host serves their price list, only encoded 4. **Exploit the legacy distcc service** - The operational logs that name Ghost and St. Catherine's
## Technical Challenge Path
- Enumerate the network and read the service banners (recon): the FTP login banner and the web host's page source - Exploit the ProFTPD 1.3.3c distribution source backdoor (compromised 2010 release; no CVE assigned; Metasploit unix/ftp/proftpd_133c_backdoor) for unauthenticated remote root - Pull and decode the ROT13-encoded exploit price list from the web host (encoding is not encryption) - Exploit the distcc daemon command execution (CVE-2004-2687, high port 3632; Metasploit unix/misc/distcc_exec) to recover the transaction log
## Narrative Payoff
The transaction log itemises invoice ZDS-2024-0847 to GHOST (Ransomware Incorporated) line by line, the same lines as the buyer's copy recovered at the hospital, then logs the deployment against St. Catherine's Regional Medical Centre. Sable approved it. It is the seller's own ledger to set beside the buyer's invoice.
